summary: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing that its sponsor deposited $229,700 into the trust account to extend the deadline to complete a business combination by one month, until July 22, 2026. In consideration, the company issued a non-interest-bearing convertible promissory note to the sponsor, convertible into units at $10.00 per unit. This is a routine extension filing by a blank-check company to give additional time for a future acquisition. No business combination has been announced, and no special-situation event has occurred. The filing simply modifies the company's timeline and creates a direct financial obligation to the sponsor.
